bead.title: Clarify conformance artifact accepted dialect list includes databricks
bead.description:
PROBLEM: The conformance acceptance artifact can still be read as spark/duckdb-only at the public dialect contract boundary, so reviewers and validators may incorrectly reject dialect="databricks" even though the implementation accepts it.
ROOT CAUSE: docs/helix/03-test/conformance-acceptance.md:49 describes the DbtDatabricks compile tier without explicitly tying it to the accepted public dialect list, and docs/helix/03-test/conformance-acceptance.md:93 documents the Databricks-facing compile UX separately from the spark/duckdb dialect contract.
PROPOSED FIX: Update docs/helix/03-test/conformance-acceptance.md so the accepted public dialect wording explicitly includes databricks alongside spark and duckdb, while preserving that internal Spark-family renderers may normalize the spelling when SQL is identical. Add a focused docs regression that fails if the accepted dialect wording regresses to spark/duckdb-only or omits dialect="databricks".
NON-SCOPE: One-shot bootstrap facade implementation. Production pipeline JSON/wheel packaging contract. Inline UMF format cleanup. No real Databricks workspace execution beyond existing opt-in tiers. GOVERNING ARTIFACTS: docs/helix/01-frame/features/FEAT-026-compile-orchestrator-bootstrap.md:84; docs/helix/03-test/conformance-acceptance.md:49; docs/helix/03-test/conformance-acceptance.md:85; docs/helix/03-test/conformance-acceptance.md:109. DEPENDENCIES: parent bead tablespec-ed74497c; child of tablespec-943b21a5; no additional dependencies.
bead.acceptance:
1. TestConformanceAcceptedDialectListIncludesDatabricks: add or update tests/docs/test_dialect_contract.py so it reads docs/helix/03-test/conformance-acceptance.md and fails unless the accepted public dialect wording names spark, duckdb, and databricks and includes public dialect="databricks".
2. TestConformanceAcceptedDialectListRejectsSparkDuckdbOnly: add or update the same docs regression so it fails on spark/duckdb-only accepted dialect language that omits databricks.
3. TestPytestGate: `uv run pytest tests/docs/test_dialect_contract.py tests/unit/test_bootstrap.py`
4. TestGoGate: `go test ./...`
5. TestLefthookGate: `lefthook run pre-commit`
